tools.name: reminders_plugin_doctor
tools.title: Check Reminders Plugin Readiness
tools.description: Run a content-free local readiness and capability diagnosis. It inspects only app/toolchain/file metadata, SQLite schema, anonymous counts, and privacy-safe permission symptoms; it does not read reminder rows or names, launch Reminders, load EventKit or private frameworks, trigger a TCC prompt, or write data.

tools.name: get_reminders_capabilities
tools.title: Get Reminders Capabilities
tools.description: Report the public EventKit bridge's supported operations and field capabilities without reading reminder content or requesting Reminders access.

tools.name: request_reminders_access
tools.title: Request Reminders Access
tools.description: Explicitly request full macOS Reminders access through EventKit. This may display a system TCC permission prompt and can change authorization state, but it does not read, create, update, complete, move, or delete reminders.

tools.name: list_reminder_accounts
tools.title: List Reminder Accounts
tools.description: List Apple Reminders accounts through Apple's public EventKit API. Returns at most limit accounts, may require macOS Reminders permission, and makes no changes.

tools.name: list_reminder_lists
tools.title: List Reminder Lists
tools.description: List Apple Reminders lists through Apple's public EventKit API, optionally scoped to one exact account ID or writable lists. Returns at most limit lists and makes no changes.

source_id.description: Optional exact account ID returned by list_reminder_accounts.

writable_only.description: Return only lists that EventKit reports as writable.

tools.name: list_reminder_sections
tools.title: List Reminder Sections
tools.description: List active sections, optionally within one exact list name, from the local default store. Returns at most limit items and makes no changes.

list_name.description: Exact list name to filter by. Omit to inspect sections across lists.

tools.name: fetch_reminders
tools.title: Fetch Reminders
tools.description: Fetch a bounded, structured page of reminders through Apple's public EventKit API. The native fetch must be bounded by calendar_ids, a complete due range with status=incomplete, or a complete completion range with status=completed. Query and modified_after are post-filters only. Continue only with the opaque next_cursor and identical filters, sort, and page size.

calendar_ids.description: One or more exact list IDs returned by list_reminder_lists.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive title or notes filter. This does not count as the required fetch bound.

due_start.description: Inclusive lower due-date bound. Without calendar_ids it must be paired with due_end and status=incomplete.

due_end.description: Exclusive upper due-date bound. Without calendar_ids it must be paired with due_start and status=incomplete.

completion_start.description: Inclusive lower completion-date bound. Without calendar_ids it must be paired with completion_end and status=completed.

completion_end.description: Exclusive upper completion-date bound. Without calendar_ids it must be paired with completion_start and status=completed.

modified_after.description: Post-filter reminders modified at or after this RFC 3339 instant. This does not bound the native EventKit fetch.

limit.description: Maximum reminders in this page. Reuse the same value with next_cursor.

sort.description: Stable page ordering. Reuse the same value with next_cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page. It is rejected if filters, sort, or page size changed.

tools.name: read_reminder
tools.title: Read Reminder
tools.description: Read one reminder by the exact opaque EventKit ID returned by fetch_reminders. EventKit IDs are valid for the current store but can change after a full sync. This makes no changes and may require macOS Reminders permission. Exceptionally long strings or arrays are bounded and reported through _mcp truncation metadata.

reminder_id.description: Exact opaque reminder ID returned by fetch_reminders.

tools.name: list_reminder_tags
tools.title: List Reminder Tags
tools.description: List reminder tag labels from the local default store. Results are bounded by limit and this tool makes no changes.

tools.name: preview_unused_reminder_tags
tools.title: Preview Unused Reminder Tags
tools.description: Preview a bounded set of tag labels with no active assignments. This is always a dry run: it never applies cleanup or deletes a label.

account_id.description: Optional exact account identifier returned by list_reminder_tags.

tools.name: cleanup_unused_reminder_tags
tools.title: Clean Up Unused Reminder Tags
tools.description: Hard-delete only the zero-reference tag-label rows in a previously previewed, untruncated candidate set. This destructive maintenance action requires the preview's exact candidate digest and the same scope; the adapter rechecks under a write lock, backs up multi-label cleanup, and verifies deletion. Tag labels have no native undo, though labels can be recreated.

tag.description: Exact canonical tag name used for the preview.

prefix.description: Literal tag-name prefix used for the preview.

account_id.description: Optional exact account identifier used for the preview.

limit.description: The same candidate bound used for the preview.

tools.name: create_reminder_list
tools.title: Create Reminder List
tools.description: Create one Apple Reminders list by exact name with optional color and emblem visual identity. If an active list with the same name already exists, the adapter returns it without creating another list.

name.description: Exact name for the new list.

color.description: Optional Reminders color name accepted by the native scripting surface.

emblem.description: Optional emoji or emblem value for the list badge.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.title: Create Reminder
tools.description: Create one reminder in an exact EventKit list ID using Apple's public API. Supports typed due dates, absolute or coordinate-backed location alarms, URL, priority, and one recurrence rule. Plain location text is intentionally unsupported because current Reminders stores discard it on read-back. A required idempotency key makes retries replay the original receipt instead of creating a duplicate.

calendar_id.description: Exact writable list ID returned by list_reminder_lists.

url.description: Optional reminder URL with an explicit scheme.

priority.description: Apple Reminders priority value from 0 through 9.

due.description: Typed all-day or timed due value. Timed values require a matching IANA time zone and UTC offset.

alarms.description: Absolute-time or geofenced location alarms. Relative alarms are intentionally unsupported.

recurrence_rules.description: At most one recurrence rule. A non-empty rule requires due.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated unique key for this logical creation. Reuse only when retrying the exact same input.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.title: Update Reminder
tools.description: Update one reminder through Apple's public EventKit API using its exact ID and the last_modified value from read_reminder or fetch_reminders. Only fields inside patch change; null explicitly clears nullable fields. A stale last_modified value fails without mutation.

reminder_id.description: Exact opaque reminder ID returned by read_reminder or fetch_reminders.

expected_last_modified.description: Exact last_modified timestamp from the most recent public EventKit read.

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.title: Complete Reminder
tools.description: Mark exactly one reminder complete through Apple's public EventKit API. Requires the exact ID and last_modified value from a recent read so a concurrent edit fails without mutation.

reminder_id.description: Exact opaque reminder ID returned by read_reminder or fetch_reminders.

expected_last_modified.description: Exact last_modified timestamp from the most recent public EventKit read.

tools.name: reopen_reminder
tools.title: Reopen Reminder
tools.description: Mark exactly one completed reminder incomplete through Apple's public EventKit API. Requires the exact ID and last_modified value from a recent read so a concurrent edit fails without mutation.

reminder_id.description: Exact opaque reminder ID returned by read_reminder or fetch_reminders.

expected_last_modified.description: Exact last_modified timestamp from the most recent public EventKit read.

tools.name: move_reminder_to_list
tools.title: Move Reminder to List
tools.description: Move exactly one reminder to exactly one destination list through Apple's public EventKit API. Requires exact reminder/list IDs and a recent last_modified precondition; no title or fuzzy matching is used.

reminder_id.description: Exact opaque reminder ID returned by read_reminder or fetch_reminders.

calendar_id.description: Exact writable destination list ID returned by list_reminder_lists.

expected_last_modified.description: Exact last_modified timestamp from the most recent public EventKit read.

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.title: Delete Reminder
tools.description: Delete exactly one reminder through Apple's public EventKit API using the exact opaque ID and a fresh last_modified precondition from read_reminder or fetch_reminders. This is destructive but follows the native Reminders deletion path; the receipt reports local absence separately from unverified Recently Deleted UI state. If the ID is no longer resolvable, the tool returns a no-write not-found result and requires a fresh read.

reminder_id.description: Exact opaque reminder ID returned by read_reminder or fetch_reminders.

expected_last_modified.description: Exact last_modified timestamp from the most recent public EventKit read.

tools.name: show_reminder
tools.title: Show Reminder in App
tools.description: Open the Reminders app and request that it show exactly one reminder selected by stable ID. This changes only local UI focus, not reminder data. The receipt confirms that Reminders accepted the handoff but does not claim that visual selection was observed.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

tools.name: purge_reminder_plugin_logs
tools.title: Purge Reminder Plugin Logs
tools.description: Delete only this plugin's bounded local redacted action journals. This is destructive and cannot be undone, but it does not delete reminders, lists, tags, attachments, caches, or backups.

tools.name: add_reminder_tag
tools.title: Add Reminder Tag
tools.description: Add one exact tag to one reminder selected by its stable reminder ID. Call list_reminder_attachments with limit=1 and pass its reminder_version so a concurrent reminder change blocks the write without loading a broad attachment set. Repeating an already-attached tag is a no-op.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

tag.description: Exact tag name, with or without a leading #.

if_version.description: Required reminder_version from a fresh list_reminder_attachments read. The tag is not added if it no longer matches.

tools.name: remove_reminder_tag
tools.title: Remove Reminder Tag
tools.description: Remove one exact tag assignment from one reminder selected by its stable reminder ID. Call list_reminder_attachments with limit=1 and pass its reminder_version so a concurrent reminder change blocks the write without loading a broad attachment set. It does not delete the global tag label.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

tag.description: Exact tag name, with or without a leading #.

if_version.description: Required reminder_version from a fresh list_reminder_attachments read. The tag is not removed if it no longer matches.

tools.name: create_reminder_section
tools.title: Create Reminder Section
tools.description: Create one section inside one list selected by its exact stable list ID through native ReminderKit, then verify the section's CloudKit version reached iCloud. If a same-name local-only section from an older plugin exists, the adapter repairs it in place instead of creating a duplicate.

list_id.description: Exact stable list UUID from list_reminder_lists.

tools.name: move_reminder_to_section
tools.title: Move Reminder to Section
tools.description: Move exactly one reminder to exactly one section through native ReminderKit and verify the list membership's CloudKit version reached iCloud. Call list_reminder_attachments with limit=1 and pass its reminder_version so a concurrent reminder change blocks the move. Repeating the same target repairs older local-only membership writes. The section must belong to the reminder's current list; no title or fuzzy matching is used.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

section_id.description: Exact stable section UUID from list_reminder_sections.

if_version.description: Required reminder_version from a fresh list_reminder_attachments read. The section move fails if it no longer matches.

tools.name: attach_image_to_reminder
tools.title: Attach Image to Reminder
tools.description: Attach one local image to exactly one reminder using the private ReminderKit path that can produce mobile-sync evidence. First call list_reminder_attachments to obtain reminder_version, then pass it as the required precondition with an absolute path and idempotency key. The backend is fixed and not caller-selectable; the receipt distinguishes verified mobile-visible evidence from pending sync.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

image_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path to the image.

if_version.description: Required reminder_version from a fresh list_reminder_attachments read.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated key for this exact image attachment; reuse only for an identical retry.

tools.name: attach_url_to_reminder
tools.title: Attach URL to Reminder
tools.description: Attach one URL to exactly one reminder selected by its stable ID. Call list_reminder_attachments first and pass its reminder_version so a concurrent reminder change blocks the write. Repeating the same URL on the same reminder is a no-op. The change may sync to the user's other Apple devices through iCloud.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL including a host.

if_version.description: Required reminder_version from a fresh list_reminder_attachments read. Attachment fails if the reminder changed after that read.

tools.name: list_reminder_attachments
tools.title: List Reminder Attachments
tools.description: List a bounded set of active attachments for one reminder selected by its exact stable ID and return reminder_version for version-guarded private existing-item mutations. This tool makes no changes.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

tools.name: audit_reminder_attachments
tools.title: Audit Reminder Attachments
tools.description: Audit a bounded set of image attachments for local/mobile-sync evidence. This is read-only and does not repair or delete attachments.

search.description: Optional text filter for reminder title or notes.

problems_only.description: Return only attachments that lack mobile-visible evidence when true.

tools.name: preview_reminder_attachment_repairs
tools.title: Preview Attachment Repairs
tools.description: Build a bounded, read-only snapshot of image attachments lacking mobile-sync evidence and return its candidate_digest. This never repairs, replaces, deletes, or backs up anything. Apply is allowed only when this preview is untruncated and the same scope/digest is supplied.

search.description: Optional reminder title/notes filter used to narrow the repair scope.

list_name.description: Optional exact list name used to narrow the repair scope.

limit.description: Maximum repair candidates in the snapshot. Narrow scope if the result is truncated.

tools.name: apply_reminder_attachment_repairs
tools.title: Apply Attachment Repairs
tools.description: Replace every candidate in one previously previewed, untruncated repair snapshot using ReminderKit, then soft-delete the old local-only attachment. Requires the exact candidate_digest and identical search/list/limit scope. A best-effort live-container backup is created by default; no_backup=true explicitly waives it. Per-item outcomes and recovery details are returned.

search.description: The exact search filter used for preview.

list_name.description: The exact list-name filter used for preview.

limit.description: The exact candidate bound used for preview.

no_backup.description: Set true only to explicitly waive the default best-effort live-container backup.

tools.name: delete_reminder_attachment
tools.title: Delete Reminder Attachment
tools.description: Delete exactly one attachment selected by its stable attachment ID from exactly one reminder selected by its stable reminder ID. URL metadata rows follow native Reminders behavior and are removed while their cloud-state tombstone is retained; image objects use the recoverable soft-delete path and copied image files are not hard-deleted. Call list_reminder_attachments first and pass its reminder_version so a concurrent reminder change blocks the deletion. No filename, URL, type, or fuzzy selector is accepted.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

attachment_id.description: Exact stable attachment UUID from list_reminder_attachments.

if_version.description: Required reminder_version from a fresh list_reminder_attachments read. Deletion fails if the reminder changed after that read.

tools.name: replace_reminder_attachment
tools.title: Replace Reminder Attachment
tools.description: Replace exactly one attachment selected by stable reminder and attachment IDs with either one absolute local image path or one HTTP(S) URL. First call list_reminder_attachments to obtain reminder_version, then pass it with an idempotency key. Image replacement uses ReminderKit and soft-deletes the old image object. URL replacement uses the private store, preserves the selected attachment's display order, and removes the old URL metadata row while retaining its cloud-state tombstone, matching native Reminders behavior. Failed image replacement is compensated when possible.

reminder_id.description: Exact reminder UUID, optionally prefixed with x-apple-reminder://.

attachment_id.description: Exact stable attachment UUID from list_reminder_attachments.

image_path.description: Absolute local image path. Mutually exclusive with url.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL. Mutually exclusive with image_path.

if_version.description: Required reminder_version from a fresh list_reminder_attachments read.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated key for this exact replacement; reuse only for an identical retry.
